title: Security: Laravel 6.20.11, 7.30.2, 8.22.1 Released
content: <html><head></head><body>This morning we released Laravel 6.20.11, 7.30.2, and 8.22.1. These updates contain a security related patch; therefore, we encourage all Laravel users to update their applications as soon as possible...</body></html>
author: Taylor Otwell
